main.description: List the authenticated user's personal shelves with per-shelf book counts, plus library-wide totals and storage usage. This is the root call for a catalog client: it carries everything the OPDS root navigation feed renders, in one request. Unpaginated — `personal_shelf` is unique on (userDid, name) and these lists are small.

totalBooks.description: Books in the library across all shelves and unshelved

storage.description: This user's storage usage against their quota
